verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an API-first product that runs headlessly by design. Its official CLI is documented as calling the API "from a terminal or script", with format selection and JMESPath field extraction for machine-readable output. An async SDK is also documented, and auth uses API keys with no OAuth flow, so non-interactive automation is straightforward. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions, env-var auth for headless runs), and independent hands-on corroboration of scripted/CI usage.
